svg.aria-label: Four projects: LabDesk, HAMS, Travelmate BD, VisionGuard

g.text: LAN classroom and lab management for Windows. An Electron client
paired with an embedded Express and Socket.IO server, screens
streamed peer-to-peer over WebRTC, and an exam-lockdown mode that
restores a safe state every time.
Hospital appointment system for patients, doctors and admins.
bcrypt-hashed sessions on every protected route and a booking
engine that rejects double-bookings server-side across the full
Bilingual Bangla and English travel assistant. A locally hosted
LLM answers from uploaded PDF and DOCX files through vector
retrieval on sentence-transformer embeddings, with a budget
Multi-label retinal disease classification across 45 labels on the
RFMiD fundus dataset under severe class imbalance. Fine-tuned
